## 1. Introduction

⟦S0004⟧ paragraph
Academic translation often breaks structural correspondence between source and target texts. A stable segment spine prevents drift.[^1]

⟦S0005⟧ paragraph
We assign each source segment a stable identifier and translate segment by segment. Prior work [1] ignores alignment; later work [2] notes it only briefly.
